verdict.rationale: Asaas documents a broad API covering charges, payment management, subscriptions, payment links, split, anticipation, subaccounts, invoices and webhooks. However, it never claims API–UI parity, and several marketed UI features have no evidenced API equivalent: credit score lookups, Serasa negativation, multi-channel dunning notifications, and ERP/inventory. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, evidenced API coverage of the credit-check, Serasa, notification-channel and ERP/stock features, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With the Asaas API, you can automate charges, receipts, and payments via Pix, bank slip (boleto), credit card, debit card, and TED.
Features such as subscriptions, payment links, split, receivables anticipation, subaccounts, invoices, and Webhooks are also available.
